targets.query:
data =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "wire_voltage_status")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serialboard_id"] == "${l_sb_id}")

    // Only use Position 1
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["position_id"] == "1")
    |> last()

wire_voltage_status =
  data
    |> set(key: "_field", value: "wire_voltage_status")
    |> keep(columns: [
        "_time",
        "_field",
        "_value",
    ])

wire_voltage_status

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^wire_voltage_[1-5]$/)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serialboard_id"] == "${l_sb_id}")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["position_id"] == "1")

  |> group(columns: ["serialboard_id", "_field"])
  |> last()

  |> group(columns: ["serialboard_id"])

  |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["serialboard_id"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      // SerialBoardID + Status
      _field:
          r.serialboard_id,

      // Voltage
      _value:
          string(v: r.wire_voltage_1) + " | " +
          string(v: r.wire_voltage_2) + " | " +
          string(v: r.wire_voltage_3) + " | " +
          string(v: r.wire_voltage_4) + " | " +
          string(v: r.wire_voltage_5) +
          (
              if r.wire_voltage_1 >= 1500 or
                 r.wire_voltage_2 >= 1500 or
                 r.wire_voltage_3 >= 1500 or
                 r.wire_voltage_4 >= 1500 or
                 r.wire_voltage_5 >= 1500
              then "."
              else ""
          )
  }))

  |> group()

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "voltage")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Voltage")

union(tables: [voltage, temperature])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

data =
  from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "current")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serialboard_id"] == "${r_sb_id}")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}")
    |> group(columns: ["current", "_field"])
    |> last()
    |> top(n:1, columns: ["_value"])

current = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "current")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Current")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

current

WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${sb_id:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["serialboard_id"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;

DECLARE @csv NVARCHAR(MAX) = '${qrcode_list}'
DECLARE @target_index INT = 0

;WITH SplitCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        value = TRIM(m.n.value('.', 'nvarchar(max)')),
        rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1
    FROM (
        SELECT CAST('<x>' + REPLACE(@csv, ',', '</x><x>') + '</x>' AS XML) AS csv_xml
    ) AS x
    CROSS APPLY x.csv_xml.nodes('/x') AS m(n)
)

SELECT value AS target_qrcode
FROM SplitCTE
WHERE rn = @target_index
